components.role: Changed gated read/write coefficients, predominantly through the learned-diagonal-scaled write into residual coordinate 163. Subsequent attention readers attenuate this difference. Its semantic role and causal behavioral importance are unidentified.

evidence: A is an arbitrary forced-choice tie-break, not an identification. Six weight-only analyses were performed without forward evaluation. Layer 4 unit 341 has a 70.02% relative diagonally scaled read/write-matrix difference; coordinate 163 accounts for 92.76% of its squared difference. Attention OV changes generally reinforce rather than compensate. These findings establish algebraic differences but do not connect them to choosing the user's guess versus the correct answer. The listed component is not claimed to be the most behaviorally important.
